Introduction sentence "For the unit group of L_k(1,d) the quotient is k^x/(k^x)^{d-1}". Not carried before. Now closed at d=2, and at general d reduced to the single named open proposition LeavittKOneFormula.ScalarKernel by printedLeavittKOneFormula_of_khanhThanh, whose other input (the Khanh-Thanh decomposition GL_d(R)=EL_d(R)D_d(k)) is discharged into ScalarSurjective by scalarSurjective_of_khanhThanh with no countability, no perfectness of EL_d and no centre computation. See $S/cc/backup/o-leavitt-k1/RESIDUAL.md for the exact remaining K-theoretic statement (Ara-Brustenga-Cortinas arXiv:0903.0056 Cor 7.7, NOT math/0412243, which is a different paper with no K_1 computation).
